title: deliver Claude's questions to Telegram and answer them from there

AC1.note: parseHookInput declines the whole call unless every question is representable; another tool, unparseable input, no options, multiSelect and blank all return null

AC2.note: questionMessage carries question, numbered options and descriptions; everything escaped, asserted with < and &

AC3.note: callback round-trip, foreign payloads rejected, payload within 64 bytes

AC4.note: denyWithAnswers is a PreToolUse deny naming each question with its chosen option

AC5.note: allAnswered requires every slot; option index zero counts

AC6.note: resolveTarget queries by project_path not by Claude's session id; forum topic preferred; half a forum config is not a target

AC7.note: insert-before-send asserted by observing the insert count from inside the first send

AC8.note: nowhere to send and any failed send both withdraw the request

AC9.note: jsonb_set with the guard in the statement; message edited; distinct outcome for not-ours/unknown/already-answered/expired/out-of-range

AC10.note: answers returned from the winning claim; null on timeout, vanished row, external expiry, non-index values, incomplete commit

AC11.note: local-only plus shared secret; body bounded; waiters capped; disconnect cancels; 204 on every terminal-keeps-it path

AC12.note: hook exits 0 silently without a token, without a bot, on timeout and on a non-question payload

AC13.note: hasOpenQuestion excludes answered and expired and is bounded to 15 minutes; checkHungSessions skips such a session

AC14.note: setupAskQuestionHook registers with matcher AskUserQuestion and timeout 600, is idempotent, prunes stale entries before the ephemeral gate

AC15.note: typecheck clean, lint 0 errors, 875 tests pass, dupes 1
